settings.layer1_body:
Radiant Life™ documents biological response over defined time-bound windows — not isolated snapshots.

Continuity, stabilization, and structured timing are prioritized over frequency and volume.

More data is not always more meaningful data.

settings.title: Why Measurement Is Time-Bound
settings.body: Defined measurement points reduce noise, placebo distortion, and short-term volatility.

settings.title: Why Data Is Not Continuously Reinterpreted
settings.body: Frequent reinterpretation creates false signals. RL100 preserves interpretability by locking conditions and evaluating outcomes only at defined intervals.

settings.title: Window Immutability
settings.body: Each 100-day window is: Timestamped. Exposure-locked. Algorithm-versioned. Non-retroactively modified. Historical records are preserved to maintain longitudinal integrity.

settings.title: What Invalidates Continuity
settings.body: Early protocol start. Mid-protocol variable changes. Missing or manipulated measurement points. Consistency preserves interpretability.
